_note: Page-level expected states, labeled by reading each saved page's own text (title, headings, fields, actions). The user's sheet labels describe the page THEY reached after their own Apply click, which often differs from the page saved by the automated click, so they are kept in each fixture as 'labels' but do not set expect_state. Written after seeing classifier output once: regression labels, not an unbiased accuracy measure.
